workloads.label: Data Ingestion
workloads.justification: Daily batch load and incremental ingestion from the 600 GB SQL Server source. Small warehouse handles under 100 GB daily incremental volume.
workloads.source: RFP Q6 - SQL Server 600 GB, 14 core tables, batch processing

workloads.label: ELT / Transformation (dbt + Snowpark)
workloads.justification: dbt pipelines, Snowpark UDFs, and Dynamic Table refreshes across Bronze-Silver-Gold layers. Small warehouse handles complex joins across 14 core tables from the 600 GB source. Also serves as the MERGE warehouse for OpenFlow CDC.
workloads.source: Gong 242442c6f6 turn 57-58 - medallion architecture, dbt, snowpark, dynamic tables, data quality

workloads.label: BI / Analytics (Power BI)
workloads.justification: Power BI import-mode refresh against the Snowflake Gold layer. X-Small warehouse is sufficient for import-mode with no DirectQuery concurrency requirement. Estimated 25 internal analyst users.
workloads.source: customer briefing - Power BI primary BI tool, import-mode refresh

workloads.label: Development / UAT
workloads.justification: Development, testing and UAT workloads for the engineering team. Available from project kickoff, consistent with the prior PoC engagement.

workloads.label: Ad-hoc / Data Science
workloads.justification: Data science exploration, vectorized embedding experiments, and analyst deep-dive queries against the Gold layer.
workloads.source: Gong 242442c6f6 turn 58-59 - vectorized embeddings, Cortex Search, AI Extract experimentation in prior PoC

workloads.label: ML Forecasting (Phase 2 - Month 13+)
workloads.justification: Snowflake ML and Snowpark-based forecasting models replacing Excel and R pipelines. Medium warehouse supports multi-dimensional forecasting across 200+ markets.
workloads.source: Gong 242442c6f6 turn 64 - forecasting Phase 2 scope; RFP Q8 - equivalents acceptable

workloads.label: BI Expansion (Phase 2 - Month 13+)
workloads.justification: Expanded Power BI and Streamlit-in-Snowflake dashboards as the legacy application layer is progressively retired. Covers the operator ranking and network transformation dashboard use cases.
workloads.source: customer briefing - Demo use cases A and B reference Streamlit-in-Snowflake and Cortex Analyst

workloads.label: Data Serving / API Layer (Phase 2 - Month 15+)
workloads.justification: Snowflake serving as primary data access layer once legacy Postgres and Elasticsearch are retired in Phase 2. 7-day availability to support the customer-facing website query load.
workloads.source: Gong 242442c6f6 turn 61 - phase 2 retires legacy stack; RFP Q5 - future state replaces Postgres

workloads.label: Data Sharing / Marketplace (Phase 3 - Month 25+)
workloads.justification: Snowflake Marketplace data product delivery and secure data sharing with operator customers. Monetises the 50 million-plus data points as curated commercial data products.
workloads.source: Glean GSMA-PoV-Plan - Marketplace listing and row-access policies for premium subscriptions

snowpipe.justification: Ingestion via OpenFlow CDC with Snowpipe metered inside OpenFlow billing; no standalone Snowpipe.

snowpipe_streaming.justification: No streaming ingestion; all data flows are batch.
snowpipe_streaming.source: RFP Q6 - nothing streaming, data moves sequentially

serverless_tasks.justification: Automated pipeline scheduling, data freshness checks, and incremental refresh orchestration.
serverless_tasks.source: customer briefing - automated ingestion with Tasks to trigger downstream pipelines

clustered_tables.justification: Automatic clustering on the two largest tables (700M and 500M rows) for BI query performance on operator and date-range filters.
clustered_tables.source: RFP Q6 - largest 2 tables have 700M/500M rows

materialized_views.justification: Dynamic Tables preferred for declarative pipeline logic.

dynamic_tables.justification: Dynamic Tables run on the ELT warehouse - no additional serverless cost.

search_optimization.justification: Cortex Search used for semantic search; traditional search optimization not required.

data_quality_monitoring.justification: Data quality monitoring across Bronze-Silver-Gold layers to enforce quality rules.
data_quality_monitoring.source: Gong 242442c6f6 turn 57-58 - data quality monitoring cited as core ELT component

replication.justification: Single-region deployment; no DR/replication requirement in RFP.

cortex_complete.justification: Agentic pipeline automation, data enrichment, and natural language classification within dbt and Snowpark pipelines.
cortex_complete.source: Stated goal to automate manual data acquisition processes

cortex_code.justification: Cortex Code assists the engineering team authoring dbt models and Snowpark pipelines.
cortex_code.source: 4-person engineering team, CLI and Snowsight surfaces

cortex_analyst.justification: Natural language query interface on the Gold layer semantic view for analyst and executive self-service.
cortex_analyst.source: customer briefing - Demo use cases A and B both reference Cortex Analyst

cortex_search.justification: Semantic search across the unstructured document corpus - regulatory filings and investor call transcripts indexed for retrieval.
cortex_search.source: Gong 242442c6f6 turn 58-59 - Cortex Search used in prior PoC alongside AI Extract

ai_extract.justification: Automated extraction from regulatory filings, investor calls, and FX reports. Replaces manual data entry. 70M tokens/month (60M input + 10M output equivalent).
ai_extract.source: Gong 242442c6f6 turn 54, 56 - PDFs, investor calls, FX data; teams of people in Delhi doing this manually

instances.label: SQL Server (wemaster) CDC
instances.justification: Daily batch CDC from the 600 GB SQL Server source (wemaster). One runtime node handles all 14 core tables within the 600-table limit. X-Small MERGE warehouse runs nightly for approximately 3 hours.
instances.source: RFP Q6 - SQL Server 600 GB, 14 core tables; Gong 242442c6f6 turn 53 - SQL server gold layer called wemaster

instances.label: PostgreSQL CDC
instances.justification: Daily batch CDC from the 16 GB PostgreSQL database (10 core tables). Shares the SPCS control pool and MERGE warehouse with the SQL Server connector.
instances.source: RFP Q6 - Postgres 16 GB, 10 core tables

standard.justification: 650 GB total source data at 3:1 structured compression.
standard.source: RFP Q6 - SQL Server 600 GB, Postgres 16 GB, ES 16 GB; unstructured documents approx 18 GB

assumptions: Operating days: weekday-only (22 days/month) for all batch workloads; Data Serving warehouse uses 30 days for customer-facing availability in Phase 2
SQL Server and PostgreSQL CDC connectors share a single OpenFlow SPCS deployment and control pool
PostgreSQL MERGE reuses the SQL Server X-Small MERGE warehouse - no additional warehouse cost
Power BI operates in import-mode refresh only (not DirectQuery); no Multi-Cluster Warehouse required
MVP scope: Data ingestion (OpenFlow CDC), ELT (dbt + Snowpark), Gold layer, and reverse ETL push to existing PostgreSQL only
Phase 2 (Month 13+): ML forecasting on Snowflake, expanded BI, PostgreSQL and Elasticsearch retirement begins
Phase 3 (Month 25+): Data monetisation via Snowflake Marketplace, data sharing with operator customers
Forecasting remains in Excel/SQL Server for MVP duration per confirmed RFP scope
Unstructured document processing (AI_EXTRACT) begins in Month 3 with the engineering team
Target deployment: AWS Europe (London) Enterprise; AWS or Azure cloud decision to be confirmed at engagement kickoff
Enterprise Edition required for Snowflake Horizon governance, RBAC policies, and data masking
AI_EXTRACT volume: 70M tokens per month (60M input plus 10M output equivalent) for regulatory filings, investor calls, and FX corpus
Cortex Search indexed volume: 30 GB for MVP document retrieval layer
Clustered tables applied to the two largest tables (700M and 500M rows) for BI query performance
Annual growth rate: 20% per year applied from Year 2 onwards
Go-live target: Q3 2026 (Month 8 from project kickoff)
OpenFlow SPCS runtime and control pool operate 24/7 (730 hr/month) as containers are always-on
MERGE warehouse hours: 90 hr/month (approximately 3 hr/night for incremental change application)
All source data volumes are batch; no streaming ingestion in MVP
Internal user count estimated at 25 Power BI users; 4-5 data engineers building the pipeline
confirm_required: Confirm exact number of concurrent Power BI users and refresh frequency - impact plus or minus 40% on BI warehouse cost if MCW is needed above 30 concurrent users
Confirm whether SQL Server and PostgreSQL are on separate physical servers - would require 2 OpenFlow SPCS deployments and double the control pool charge
Confirm if the existing ELT warehouse can serve as the MERGE warehouse for OpenFlow CDC - would eliminate the dedicated X-Small MERGE cost (saves approx 90 credits/month)
Confirm total table count across full SQL Server CDC scope - 14 core tables confirmed but full schema may include additional tables approaching the 600-table runtime limit
Confirm AI_EXTRACT token volumes for the regulatory filing and investor call corpus - 70M tokens estimated; impact plus or minus 50% on Year 1 AI costs
Confirm whether Cortex Search is in MVP scope or deferred to Phase 2 - deferring saves approx 189 AI credits/month in Year 1
Confirm final cloud provider selection (AWS or Azure) - minor impact on credit rates
Confirm Organisation Management System ingestion mechanism - 9,000 organisations confirmed via database connectivity in Q7; table count may require a dedicated OpenFlow runtime node
Confirm Phase 2 kickoff timeline - sizing assumes Month 13 start for ML forecasting and legacy retirement; a later Phase 2 start shifts TCV from Year 2 to Year 3
